findings.text: The fast operator pin compares only control["selected_cells"] (3 of 228 shell cells) unless NOVA_LINEAR_OPERATOR_REFERENCE is set, which no gate sets; with ~30 quadrature points per cell the 4096-point flush in linear_galerkin_cell_interaction and the tile-boundary skip in _linear_edge_mutual are never crossed, so a regression confined to a flush or tile boundary leaves the suite green. The full-shell check exists only as a separate receipt (paired-full-shell-negative.log, 6.0e-15).

The done_when quantitative bar (10 mm 3168-cell linear assembly at most 900 s on one P100) is unmet at 4107.743 s, 4.6x over. The miss is recorded honestly at lines 7-8 and 55 as a measured outcome under the coordinator's ruling, so the node does not misreport.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit across 23 commits and 18 files: the tile-owner reuse, pairwise/flux-only evaluator flags, batched cell quadrature, the reference revision guard, new cost scripts, four new tests and the evidence fragment and figure.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when demands a compile/execute split receipt, a 1e-12 operator pin with a failing negative control, constant bit identity, and the 10 mm solve plus figure; the manifest names the gate pytest command and both arms are readable (59 passed base, 63 passed head, EXIT=0).
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to cut the piecewise-linear Galerkin assembly cost and complete the 10 mm closed-shell row; nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:2028-2168 routes the polygon quadrature through the existing tile owner and nova/biot/magnetisation.py:250 completes the linear 10 mm row via a persisted interaction solved on rigel CPU.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it states status complete, records 59 passed baseline and 63 passed in 6638.00s after, zero failures, names its five test logs and its negative_control_log, and cites the GPFS receipts.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the six declared paths in the source prompt (prompt.txt:155-160); all 18 files in the diff lie inside nova/biot/tiledassembly.py, tests/test_magnetisation.py, scripts/iron_linear_magnetisation and the named docs/evidence and docs/figures paths.

justifications.durability: tests/test_magnetisation.py:1235 compares the head operator against the delivered blob 919fc749 loaded from git at control revision 0d4ad57d, and the recorded mutant reddens it, but tests/test_magnetisation.py:1205 pins only 3 of 228 shell cells in the gate; the full shell is a separate receipt.
justifications.evidence: The after-final/after-suites.log records 63 passed, EXIT=0 at the exact head and the paired-full-shell-negative.log records the mutant failing at 0.0254 Frobenius with EXIT=1, so the measurement is recorded rather than claimed.
justifications.fit: The change keeps the existing TilePlan/tile_evaluator vocabulary and extends tiledassembly.__all__ at nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:1919 with the three linear entry points; no plan, version or ticket label appears in any symbol, path or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:2038 folds the per-cell polygon trace into tile_evaluator and the receipts show 40/20/10 mm walls of 403.4/821.0/4107.7 s against the delivered 901.0/1780.3/8906.1 s, so the cost is cut 2.17-2.23x and the 10 mm row completes, though the 900 s bar is missed.
justifications.reuse: nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:2104 replaces the duplicate _traced_psi_gradient polygon evaluator with tile_evaluator and scales/_linear_edge_mutual reuse pad_batch and TilePlan; scripts/iron_linear_magnetisation/figure.py:25 wraps the shared save_checked rather than reimplementing the text check, and load_owner in kernel_cost.py:20 follows the existing prototype module load_owner idiom, for which no single owner exists.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in git diff --stat 79a578d..0b6ec2d2f lies inside the six declared write paths and no out-of-scope source file is touched.
